input.summary: Add Company right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid, unearned fees
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only permits convenience termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so on an evergreen term we would be locked into every engagement; we have added a Company right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid, unearned fees, with Contractor paid for Services performed through termination. If 30 days is difficult we can move to 60 days' notice.

ops.text: (c) In addition, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, without penalty or early-termination charge. Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses incurred or earned for Services properly performed through the effective date of termination, and Contractor shall refund to Company any prepaid fees for Services not performed as of that date.
